Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
HARTING stands for strong connections – across the globe. As one of the leading international suppliers of industrial connectivity, we are connecting customers to their digital future. And as an employer? We connect around 6,000 people at our headquarter in Espelkamp and at locations worldwide. Here you’ll find great colleagues, as well as ever new opportunities and innovations revolving around IoT and artificial intelligence. In everything we do, we remain true to our roots: as a regionally connected family business that always stays firmly grounded in spite of our stellar high-tech. Here’s to your unique future with us: Yours!
 Functional Objectives
Establish and enforce a consistent Angular front-end architecture (with measurable code quality outcomes)
Build and govern a reusable UI component library / design system with strong adoption and CI/CD-ready delivery
 Is Responsible For
Define, further develop and enforce a consistent front-end architecture
Architecture and design decisions in close coordination with the backend team
Active participation in central front-end components and architecture-critical areas
Ensuring code quality, clean code, best practices and sustainable maintainability
Building, maintaining and governance of UI component libraries and design systems
Collaborate on technical standards in the area of build, test, and deployment (CI/CD) processes in collaboration with DevOps teams
Close cooperation with UX/UI designers and product owners for continuous improvement of the user experience
Mentoring and coaching of front-end developers as well as promotion of professional development in the team
Evaluation of new technologies, frameworks and architectural approaches as well as derivation of strategic recommendations
Active participation in technical decision-making processes regarding new technologies, frameworks and architectural approaches
Collaboration in the international front-end team
 Education And Professional Knowledge
At least 5 years of experience as a Senior Frontend Engineer, Frontend Architect or Frontend Lead
Very good knowledge of modern frontend technologies with a focus on Angular
Sound knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 and modern frontend architectures
Experience in the integration of frontends with CMS systems and eCommerce systems
Experience with automated tests in the frontend (e.g. Jest, Cypress, Playwright)
Understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience working with DevOps and cloud teams (e.g., Azure DevOps)
Strong communication skills as well as experience in leading and coaching developers
Very good knowledge of English
 Nice To Have
Experience with performance optimization and web accessibility (e.g. WCAG)
Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, preferably in the Azure environment
 Benefits: Flexibility (RO), Meal tickets (RO), Medical services (RO), Annual bonus salary (RO), Recreational activities (RO)
